name: Takinaka Amahiko
source:
Sayone's childhood friend. 
Good at chanting and dancing.
Although he is a cute looking boy, he has a frosty personality which makes people want to kick him in the face. He's especially bitter with women.
He comes from a wealthy family where the skill of [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noh]Noh[/url] is passed from generation to generation. You can say that anyone from his house is a local celebrity.
His favorite thing is plum wine.

[Edited and translated from the [url=http://www.ray-software.net/tokihako/index.html]official website[/url]]
